avoidWhen.text: Avoid offering undo for destructive commands that cannot be reversed; use destructive-confirm beforehand.

customize.text: Choose whether the undo offer sits in a non-blocking toast or an inline confirmation bar.

keep.text: Announces the completed reversible action in a polite status region.
Provides an operable Undo button reachable by keyboard focus.
Fits a narrow viewport without clipping the Undo button.
Activating Undo invokes the result's undoCommand with its undoArgs rather than reimplementing reversal in the UI.

default.text: Mount a reversible mutation result from spec/wire/result-success-full.json with a status region and an operable Undo button.

summary: Offer an immediate, keyboard-reachable Undo action inside a polite status notice after a reversible mutation.

useWhen.text: Use when a command declares undoable: true or returns undoCommand and undoArgs so the person can take the change back immediately.
